soil_mechanics_primer.title: Soil Compaction & Bulk Density
soil_mechanics_primer.summary: Root elongation ceases when soil penetrometer resistance exceeds 300 PSI. Mechanical air fracturing restores macropore volume without tearing root vascular tissue.
soil_mechanics_primer.diagnostic_threshold: Diagnostic Indicator: Subsurface bulk density exceeding 1.6 g/cm3 and penetrometer readings over 300 PSI arrest root elongation.

soil_mechanics_primer.title: Root Collar Lenticel Aeration
soil_mechanics_primer.summary: Trunk bark tissue lacks protective suberin barriers found in roots. Grade changes or turf buildup cause anaerobic moisture trapping, adventitious girdling roots, and fungal pathogen ingress.
soil_mechanics_primer.diagnostic_threshold: Diagnostic Indicator: Buried root collars exceeding 4 to 6 inches of mineral fill show high susceptibility to hypoxia and vascular constriction.

soil_mechanics_primer.title: Soil Carbon Sponge & Infiltration
soil_mechanics_primer.summary: Blending pyrolyzed biochar with active compost builds stable aggregate structure, expanding water retention in heavy vertisols and recharging local karst aquifers.
soil_mechanics_primer.diagnostic_threshold: Diagnostic Indicator: Post-treatment water infiltration rate deltas confirm macropore connectivity and living soil sponge establishment.
